_readme: Admin file: edit one object to change a photo card. Empty string = not filled yet (do not invent numbers). type must be slab|log|veneer|table|epoxy. lane must be A_placi|B_furnir|C_special. sort is display order (Home featured is C0-A03). slab/log/veneer render on /stock; table/epoxy on /portfolio. Stock L/W/T on A02–A06/B04 are demo/estimate until Saturday. A09 length/width are from chalk.
